sources.title: Iron Age and Megaliths, Encyclopedia of Archaeology
sources.note: Current archaeological synthesis describing a mosaic of local traditions, chronology, farming, metallurgy, monuments, and continuity.

sources.title: The Megalithic Iron Age Culture in South India: Some General Remarks
sources.note: Scholarly regional review of chronology, material culture, mortuary forms, settlements, and interpretive limits.

sources.title: The Iron Age in India
sources.note: Institutional archaeological synthesis of iron, black-and-red ware, megalithic funerary practice, production, and disputed dating.

sources.title: Copper and Iron Age: Features and Distribution
sources.note: Government academic module on southern and Vidarbha sites, iron tools, pottery, graves, and regional distributions.

sources.title: Iron Age to Early Historic Transition in South India
sources.note: Government academic account of uneven technological, agricultural, settlement, trade, and political transitions.

sources.title: Megaliths of South India: Regional Variants
sources.note: Government academic typology stressing geological and regional variation in monument forms.

sources.title: Pre-historic Cultures in India
sources.note: Government academic outline defining cists, dolmens, stone circles, hood stones, menhirs, and related categories.

sources.title: Hire Benkal, Megalithic Site
sources.note: Official Indian tentative-list dossier for the protected cemetery, its varied monuments, water basin, quarrying, and landscape.

sources.title: Kodumanal excavation
sources.note: Tamil Nadu archaeology account of habitation, cairn-circle excavation, ceramics, beads, weapons, and grave goods.

sources.title: Archaeological excavation at Adichanallur
sources.note: Tamil Nadu archaeology record for current official work at the Iron Age urn-burial complex.

sources.title: Archaeological excavations conducted by the Department of Archaeology
sources.note: Official excavation register distinguishing Iron Age, megalithic, Neolithic, and Early Historic projects.

sources.title: The Cultural Heritage of Tamil Nadu
sources.note: State archaeology guide to Sanur, urns, sarcophagi, iron objects, pottery, fauna, and varied southern sites.

sources.title: Ongoing Archaeological Excavations in Tamil Nadu: Status Report
sources.note: Official field report on Kodumanal furnaces, ceramics, river setting, craft production, and transition questions.

sources.title: Excavations at Adichchanallur
sources.note: Archaeological Survey of India excavation report for urn burials, human remains, grave furnishings, and site sequence.

sources.title: Phytolith records from megalithic burials at Porunthal
sources.note: Peer-reviewed study of rice, millet, sedges, palms, grazing, processing, and differentiated grave deposits around 540 to 410 BCE.

sources.title: Dry, rainfed or irrigated? Rice agriculture in Iron Age-Early Historic South India
sources.note: Peer-reviewed archaeobotanical reassessment separating rice evidence from unsupported universal irrigation assumptions.

sources.title: Archaeologies of flow: Water and landscapes of Southern India
sources.note: Peer-reviewed landscape study of hilltop settlement continuity, harvesting, small reservoirs, and ritual water associations.

sources.title: Tank Irrigation System of the Megalithic Builders in South India: A Reassessment
sources.note: Institutional reassessment distinguishing observed bunds and settlement associations from broad irrigation claims.

sources.title: Iron technology of ancient megalithic communities in Vidarbha
sources.note: Peer-reviewed metallographic study of production, burial and habitation objects, regional chronology, and technological variability.

sources.title: Microstructural and elemental analysis of iron artefacts from Kaveri valley sites
sources.note: Peer-reviewed materials analysis of iron and steel objects from Kodumanal and related Kaveri contexts.

sources.title: Craft production and technology at Kodumanal
sources.note: Author-accessible scholarly study of bead, shell, ceramic, metal, and textile production organization.

sources.title: Stone bead and ornament production in Early Historic South India
sources.note: Peer-reviewed comparison of Kodumanal and other southern production communities, techniques, and communities of practice.

sources.title: Regional perspectives on Megalithic landscapes
sources.note: Academic project report on cemetery distribution, monument diversity, scale, social differentiation, and landscape method.

sources.title: The politics and historicity of megalithic places in early South India
sources.note: Peer-reviewed Maski landscape study of long monument histories, collective action, food production, manure, and remembrance.

sources.title: Social distinctions during the south Indian Neolithic
sources.note: Radiocarbon-based study showing gradual change in coffins, sarcophagi, feasting, stone elements, and social affiliation.

sources.title: Prehistoric Mortuary Practices and the First Radiocarbon Dates from Maski
sources.note: Peer-reviewed chronological study emphasizing local occupational history and the limits of undated culture labels.

sources.title: Grounding texts and theories of societal change
sources.note: Peer-reviewed survey dating Vidarbha settlements, megaliths, fortified sites, and ceramic assemblages by phase.

sources.title: Possible paleopathological evidence of treponematosis from Agripalle
sources.note: Peer-reviewed diagnosis from one Iron Age megalithic skull and a clear warning against population-wide inference.

sources.title: Dental microwear from Adichchanallur and Keeladi
sources.note: Peer-reviewed dental study using adult remains to investigate diet and food processing across two southern sites.

sources.title: Megalithic burials of South India: Definitions and observations
sources.note: University repository study of mortuary definitions, graveyard separation, human remains, and regional burial variability.

sources.title: Megalithic Markings in Context: Kudatini burial pots
sources.note: Contextual study of post-firing marks on pots in a child burial, ritual repetition, and limits on treating signs as text.

sources.title: The Beginnings of Civilization in South India
sources.note: Scholarly discussion of early Tamil-Brahmi evidence and its later, uneven archaeological contexts.

sources.title: Astronomical significance of Nilurallu stone alignment
sources.note: Academic archaeoastronomical study testing orientations at one Andhra Pradesh alignment without generalizing to all monuments.

sources.title: History of South Indian Agriculture and Agroecosystems
sources.note: University synthesis of crops, ecology, farming histories, and limits of uniform regional narratives.

sources.title: Deccan Megaliths
sources.note: Peer-reviewed educational synthesis of monument forms, chronology, ceramics, standing stones, and interpretive caution.
